about_the_game:
This game is based on a third-person shooter, but shooting is part of the game.

When I was a kid, my favorite games were hide and seek and tag. I tried to implement these games from my childhood into a game.

The difficulty of this game depends on your play style. Although it is a shooter, the goal is not to kill enemies.

The bigger goal is to outwit or tease enemies in a cool way. You can use various traps, or you can choose to escape from enemy sight.

It is up to you to choose which method you want. It is almost impossible to kill enemies. Killing enemies is not the goal.

Play a game that reminds you of hide and seek from your childhood. Try different game styles.

content_descriptors.notes: Just nudity. No sex. No self-harm, no drugs.
